description: The 'xzibit_projects_copy' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various software projects, capturing essential details such as project identifiers, ownership, and status. This dataset is particularly useful for project management and tracking purposes, as it includes information on who owns each project, whether the project is a tutorial, and its current status. Additionally, it records the last modification date, which is crucial for understanding the project's timeline and updates. The dataset also includes descriptive fields like 'shortDesc' and 'tags', which offer insights into the project's purpose and categorization. The 'contributors' field, although currently empty, is intended to list individuals who have contributed to the project, providing a collaborative aspect to the dataset. This dataset is valuable for organizations looking to manage and analyze their project portfolios, ensuring that all relevant information is easily accessible and up-to-date. It can be used to track project progress, allocate resources efficiently, and identify areas that require attention or improvement.
shortDesc: Dataset of software projects with details on ownership and status.

columns.name: projectKey
columns.comment: Unique identifier for each project, key for tracking.

columns.name: ownerLogin
columns.comment: Username of the project owner, indicates responsibility.

columns.name: tutorialProject
columns.comment: Indicates if the project is a tutorial, boolean value.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Title of the project, descriptive name.

columns.name: projectStatus
columns.comment: Current status of the project, e.g., 'Sandbox'.

columns.name: contributors
columns.comment: List of project contributors, JSON array format.

columns.name: lastModifiedOn
columns.comment: Timestamp of last modification, tracks updates.

columns.name: shortDesc
columns.comment: Brief description of the project, free text.

columns.name: tags
columns.comment: Categorical labels for the project, JSON array format.
